advisories.title: PHP2Shell
advisories.summary: Flaws in PHP can let a remote attacker run code on the server.
advisories.action: Update to a PHP image at or above the fixed version for your branch.

advisories.title: Node.js Brotli
advisories.summary: A flaw in Node.js Brotli handling can be abused to crash or take over a service.
advisories.action: Update to a Node.js image at or above the fixed version for your branch.
